config.text: Open-Meteo weather tools are installed (no API key required, free for non-commercial use). When the user asks about weather, forecast, rain, temperature, wind, snow, humidity, air quality, marine/wave conditions, flood risk, or historical climate at any location, call the relevant `open_meteo.*` tool — geocode first to resolve a place name to coordinates, then forecast / historical / marine / air_quality as appropriate. Don't guess weather values; the tool is fast and accurate.

edges.when: let t = event.payload.text.to_lower(); t.contains("weather") || t.contains("forecast") || t.contains("temperature") || t.contains("rain") || t.contains("snow") || t.contains("wind") || t.contains("humidity") || t.contains("climate") || t.contains("sunny") || t.contains("cloudy") || t.contains("storm") || t.contains("hot") || t.contains("cold") || t.contains("degrees") || t.contains("celsius") || t.contains("fahrenheit") || t.contains("air quality") || t.contains("uv index")
